text:
Northwind Regional will open a hub at Castellane Airfield on 14 April 2026, with the first scheduled departures leaving that morning.

Marguerite Ostrand, the airline's Chief Operating Officer, announced the hub at a press conference on 9 February, where the Castellane Airfield Authority unveiled its signed Hub Operating Agreement with the carrier.

The hub will begin with 38 weekly departures and create about 420 local jobs, according to the agreement.

Ostrand said the airline chose Castellane because the airfield offered room to grow and a workforce ready to take on the work. "We are building this hub to last, and we intend to build it with people from this community," she said.

The agreement sets out how Northwind Regional will operate from the airfield. Airport officials said the signing marks the start of the preparations needed before the April opening.

Further details on recruitment and the departure schedule are expected closer to the launch date.
